description:
Signed-off-by: NAYANA.R <nayana.r7813@gmail.com>

closes #4440 
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  ✅ Change 1: Define asserted_keys tuple (line 145)                                                                                                                                                                                                 
  asserted_keys = ("boot_mode", "effective_mode", "override_active", "cluster_propagation")
  - Correct: Defines the complete set of fields that will be asserted                                                                                                                                                                                
  - Benefits: DRY principle - single source of truth                                                                                                                                                                                                 
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     
  ✅ Change 2: Enhanced convergence predicate (line 152)                                                                                                                                                                                             
  # Before:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          
  if mcp_rt.get("effective_mode") == admin.get("effective_mode"):                                                                                                                                                                                    
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     
  # After:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           
  if all(mcp_rt.get(key) == admin.get(key) for key in asserted_keys):                                                                                                                                                                                
  - Correct: Now checks ALL 4 fields for convergence                                                                                                                                                                                                 
  - Fixes the bug: Prevents premature loop exit when only effective_mode matches                                                                                                                                                                     
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     
  ✅ Change 3: Reuse asserted_keys in assertion loop (line 155)                                                                                                                                                                                      
  # Before:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          
  for key in ("boot_mode", "effective_mode", "override_active", "cluster_propagation"):      
 # After:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           
  for key in asserted_keys:
  - Correct: Ensures consistency between convergence check and assertions                                                                                                                                                                            
  - Maintains correctness: Same fields checked in both places
